convergence.pencilVersionNote: 0.3.4 (the lab pin) has a headless scene-load defect: any .pen with relative `imports`/`fonts` URIs fails 'Base URI must be absolute!' and imported tokens render black. 0.3.5 fixes it. This file imports hemlock-library.lib.pen, so the re-export MUST run on >=0.3.5 — flagged for the environment-facts ratchet.
convergence.exportInvocation: pen interactive --in <file.pen> --out <file.pen>; execute({ input: 'Export(["<frameId>", ...], "png", "<dir>")' }) — default scale 2; cwd irrelevant but the .pen MUST be at its committed lane path so the relative library import resolves. Re-export verified byte-deterministic across consecutive runs.
convergence.comparison: pixelmatch threshold 0.1 (harness convention), per-state budget 1.0% (dispatch default); targets = normalized prototype, contract root #card, Chromium 151 (playwright 1.58), deviceScaleFactor 2, capture protocol v2.1 (freeze CSS, fonts ready, pointer parking, self-consistency gate). Heebo rendered from the same TTF the .pen references (pencil/designs/fonts/Heebo-VariableFont_wght.ttf, installed into fontconfig).
convergence.iterationNotes: Iteration 1 (authoring from extracted prototype geometry, text baseline offset 0) converged all 9 states at 0.028-0.25%. Iteration 2 probed text-baseline compensation (+0.5/-0.5/+1px) — every variant measured worse (0.15-0.73%), so iteration 1 stands as final. Residual is cross-rasterizer text antialiasing plus arc-edge AA; default and static-print exports are byte-identical, matching the contract's identical-by-construction claim.

tokenJudgmentCalls.surface: card text (--fg: legend labels/values, tooltip title/value)
tokenJudgmentCalls.rationale: Pure black has no Hemlock role; the body-text role owns all card copy. Warm gray-700 replaces #000 in light.
Legend rows are interactive rows; the named row-hover role (taupe #F7F5F0) wins over generic sem-background-hover (gray #F8F7F6) despite Bill's neutral gray.

tokenJudgmentCalls.surface: keyboard focus ring on legend rows
tokenJudgmentCalls.rationale: Hemlock's a11y contract names sem-borders-focus as THE focus ring; role-first binding turns the ring near-black (#0e0e0e) in light. Deliberate divergence from the prototype's blue ring.
Empty/inactive surface region; nearest role is the subtle background (gray-100 #EEEDEB).
Hemlock chart rules pin tooltip bg to sem-background-surface; hairline border/rule to the default light border role.

hemlock-library has component/DonutChart variants, but they are a different design (center total, ellipse segments, own card chrome) that cannot reproduce the executable spec's geometry (EPS anti-seam overlaps, explode vectors, exact 12-o'clock anchor). Under the two-oracle split the .pen is the pixel oracle OF THIS prototype, so frames carry the prototype's exact path data with token paint; composing the library component would fail every pixel compare. Divergence from Hemlock's existing DonutChart is a designer-visible fact, not silently resolved here.

tokenJudgmentCalls.prototypeValue: runtime-computed: hot = gain(base,1.09), dim = mix(base, surface, 0.42)
tokenJudgmentCalls.rationale: Design-rules 7/22: tones are build-time functions of the base token, never runtime compositing. Materialized as tokens (light derived vs #ffffff surface, dark derived vs #131C31) so no frame carries a raw hex; a base-token swap mechanically re-derives them.

appliesTo: all frames: slice 0 fill, legend swatch 0, tooltip dot
companions mono-01-hot #0E74E6/#1B88FF and mono-01-dim #99C0ED/#164581 on focus states
